checks.name: unavailable Find is omitted from help and Ctrl/Cmd+F opens find only in conversation
checks.evidence:
AssertionError: The input was expected to not match the regular expression /Ctrl \/ Cmd \+ F/. Input:

'Use + to create a coworker. Organize existing history under Conversations. Your drafts and chats stay in this browser.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Ctrl / Cmd + K\tOpen commands\n' +
  'Ctrl / Cmd + F\tFind in conversation\n' +
  'Enter\tSend or queue the composer message\n' +
  'Shift + Enter\tAdd a new line in the composer\n' +
  'Enter / Shift + Enter\tNext / previous match while finding\n' +
  'Escape\tClose the current menu, find bar, or dialog\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Commands open local controls. Sending a message is a separate action. Shortcuts do not override an open settings or editing dialog.'
checks.limitation: Browser-local shortcut check; native browser find is not used when unavailable.
